text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the Tenno Sho (Autumn), where the strongest assemble,
summer training camp arrived,
offering high hopes for major growth.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Under normal circumstances,
I shouldn't have been able to get back up at all anymore.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Starting today, though, what we're doing ain't some pointless struggle.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I suppose it would.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Even so, there's a limit to how fast she can grow."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Unlike the 'new generation,'
who are brimming with hope—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Yo.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Is it really alright for a sheltered little "Highness"
to be in such a sweltering place like this?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, I'm making my debut too, you know!
Surely you knew that, right?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Right down to the fact that there are conditions attached.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: You see, I'm studying abroad, right? I was only given permission to enter races for the three years until I return to my country.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "I intend to enjoy the time I've been given to the absolute fullest♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'd be really happy if I could run together
with you at the training camp too, Shakur! Looking forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She talks about it so casually, but...
I wonder how it feels to see the end right from the beginning. Besides—"
choice_data_list: Somehow, she reminds me of Shakur.
Somehow, she reminds me of Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Where's the proof?
...What do you mean?
choice_data_list: It feels like I know my own destiny, somehow...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Fact is, you already know and get it, don'tcha?
Just in a totally different way from me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she...
understands her own destiny.
choice_data_list: You mean keeping it unchanged on purpose?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: 100 percent.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, none of that matters.
In any case, even if the top contenders drop out, our rivals are only going to multiply."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Keep your eyes peeled on your surroundings too.
Scraping together data is hard work, y'know.
Put in more work than a cat, at least, alright?"
